scopes.guidance: Create a draft with value, then change status through a patch of /status. Read by entity key or lowercase hex24 ID; a hex24 selector is treated as an ID. Writes require the returned ID. Read revision before each write. For A/B create, omit top-level key and ifMatch; put the entity key in flat value.key, without a data wrapper. For update, pass key as the lowercase hex24 id returned by configs.get and ifMatch as its positive revision; patch paths address the flat record, e.g. /name. Illustrative configs.write create and patch (read actual IDs/revisions and choose the test window before use): {"scope":"ab-tests","value":{"key":"onboarding","name":"Onboarding","filters":{},"startAt":"2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z","auditory":100,"groups":[{"key":"control","name":"Control","capacity":100},{"key":"variant","name":"Variant","capacity":100}]},"idempotencyKey":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001","dryRun":true}; {"scope":"ab-tests","key":"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa","ifMatch":1,"patch":[{"op":"replace","path":"/name","value":"Updated onboarding"}],"idempotencyKey":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002","dryRun":true}
Get without key reads locale settings; key selects locale strings. Use format=xliff for import/export.
Without key, list metadata (100 per page; filter is a key prefix). With key, read metadata; include=versions needs key and a locale filter.
The ifMatch value is the whole settings ETag returned by get.
